key_variables: ambient pressure;O2 mole fraction;droplet size;fuel;inert/suppressant composition;drift/sub-buoyant flow

p0_candidate_reason: Covers liquid-fuel fire behavior and extinction, complementing BASS-II's solid fuels; highly useful for cross-material fire-safety queries.
